analysis:mixed_move_report_tomorrow.description: Falls about twice as far as its peers, the day before reporting.
analysis:mixed_move_report_tomorrow.first_output:
AMD fell 4.2% to $161.30, underperforming both the broader market (SPY down 0.6%) and its AI compute peers, which declined a median of 2.0%. The stock's move appears mixed, falling more sharply than the semiconductor theme but in the same direction, while the only coverage notes that the company reports third-quarter earnings after the close tomorrow.

The earnings setup shows AMD typically moves around 6.1% (abnormal to its market model) on results, but beating estimates has not reliably driven the stock higher—all seven recent reports beat expectations, yet three saw negative abnormal reactions the next session, including the last report in August (beat by 4.1%, fell 7.0% abnormal). AMD reports third-quarter results tomorrow, October 9th, after the close.
